left.title: Planned Parenthood Has Ousted Its President, Leana Wen, In A Dispute Over The Organization's Direction
left.body: Planned Parenthood President Leana Wen was removed from her position by the organization’s board “at a secret meeting,” due to “philosophical differences over the direction and future of Planned Parenthood,” Wen said in a tweet Tuesday. She was in the position for less than a year. “I believe that the best way to protect abortion care is to be clear that it is not a political issue but a health care one,” Wen tweeted in a statement about her sudden termination.
left.roundup: Planned Parenthood removed president Dr. Leana Wen from office on Tuesday. Most left-leaning media focused on the reasons she was removed, citing poor leadership and lack of involvement in Planned Parenthood's political campaigns. Much of the right-leaning media also focused on her leadership qualities, while sometimes painting abortion and Planned Parenthood in a negative light.

center.title: Planned Parenthood Removes Leana Wen As President After Less Than A Year
center.body: Planned Parenthood's President Leana Wen was removed from the position on Tuesday after less than a year on the job. In a statement on Twitter, Wen said the decision was made during a "secret meeting." "I am leaving because the new Board Chairs and I have philosophical differences over the direction and future of Planned Parenthood," Wen said in a statement on Twitter.

right.title: Planned Parenthood President Ousted after Less Than a Year in Charge
right.body: Leana Wen, a physician who has led Planned Parenthood since last fall, announced via Twitter this afternoon that she has been ousted from her position by the board of the Planned Parenthood Federation of America.
